thread:
Alex (AE): Quick sync — Plantree wants a 6-week POC for smart search + assistant across ~2M docs. Key asks: support 64k context for long doc summarization, tool-calling for DB lookups, retrieval+embedding + reranker pipeline, enterprise controls (KMS, VPC). Need to align success criteria and call out blockers (pricing/contract/Sec). Can SE/solutions own tech scoping + pricing callouts?
Priya (SE): I can take tech scoping. Quick clarifying q's: are they expecting multi-turn doc followups (yes/no), and what's acceptable latency for query->answer? Also do they need on-prem/private from day 1 or is hosted OK for POC?
Janelle (Plantree): Multi-turn yes, users will iterate on results. Target 300-500ms median for simple retrieval answers, 1.5s ok for longer summarizations. Hosted ok for POC but must be able to export logs and sign NDA.
Ben (Solutions Eng): For the pipeline I'd recommend: 1) dense embeddings for retrieval (we can use ~1536-d open model), 2) candidate retrieval top-K, 3) cross-encoder reranker (smaller specialized model) for precision, 4) LLM for synthesis with tool-calls to fetch live metadata. We'll need eval prompts + held-out queries to measure MRR/precision@5 and hallucination rate.
Priya (SE): Model fit notes: if they want 64k context for long doc summarization we'll probably use a 32k context model + chunking + overlap or a 64k variant if they insist on single-pass summarization. Tool calling: function-calling for DB fetches is straightforward — we should prototype using the function schema to ensure deterministic retrievals. Example quick snippet for function call payload:
```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-64k-lite",
  "input": "Summarize document X, then call get_metadata(doc_id) if needed",
  "functions": [{"name": "get_metadata", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"doc_id": {"type": "string"}}}}]
}
```
Ben (Solutions Eng): For reranker, measure latency added — cross-encoder will add ~50-120ms per candidate depending on hardware. We can mitigate with smaller candidate set or distilled reranker. Also recommend running synthetic eval set: 200 queries, graded relevance, and 50 safety/regression prompts.
Tomas (Pricing): Pricing question: what QPS & expected avg tokens per request? Hosted cost vs Dedicated reserved capacity comparison will depend heavily on concurrency and token mix. Need estimates to give accurate quote.
Janelle (Plantree): Expect ~15 qps peak, avg 600 tokens per session (retrieval + synth), spikes to 50 qps during analytics. POC traffic will be ~10% of that.
Marta (Security): For enterprise blockers: confirm KMS integration (customer keys), VPC peering for Private, SOC2 + penetration test timeline. Also need SCIM + SSO (SAML/OIDC). If they require on-prem from day one, that extends delivery by ~6 weeks.
Alex (AE): Noted. Action items: @Priya prototype tool-calling + 64k vs chunking test (due in 1 week), @Ben assemble eval set + baseline metrics (2 weeks), @Tomas price hosted POC vs 3-month Dedicated commit (EOD Wed), @Marta send Plantree our security checklist and flag any must-haves that block POC. Janelle — I'll share the data access form and NDA.
Priya (SE): I'll mock up a reduced dataset and run both chunked 32k flow and a single 64k model to compare latency and token cost. Will report with sample prompts and cost estimate.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Will provide suggested reranker config and expected precision/latency tradeoffs. Also recommend adding a small regression alert: if MRR drops >5% after a model change, auto-rollback.
Janelle (Plantree): Sounds good. Can Plantree share 20 anonymized queries and 10 docs for the test set today?
Alex (AE): Please upload to the secure drop I just shared + confirm NDA. If we get the sample data today we can start POC infra next week. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Deploy job queued for dedicated-poc-test (not executed until SE sign-off).
